records.source: It's a statue of a chicken on a bronze base. The ancient people of this area must have been very fond of chickens.
records.translation: Rebulto ito ng manok sa tansong tuntungan. Tiyak na labis na kinagigiliwan ng mga sinaunang tao sa lugar na ito ang mga manok.

records.englishResidueReason: Amphora is the conventional archaeological name for this specific ancient vessel.

records.source: An ancient vessel made of ceramic material. Used to transport both dry and wet goods.
records.translation: Sinaunang sisidlang gawa sa seramika. Ginagamit sa paghahatid ng tuyo at basang paninda.

records.source: Rich and moist with a thick fudge icing.
records.translation: Malasa at mamasa-masa, na may makapal na palamang fudge.
records.englishResidueReason: Fudge is the conventional borrowed Filipino name for this specific confection and icing style.

records.preserveReason: Chowder is the conventional borrowed culinary name for this specific thick soup.

records.source: A perfect way to warm yourself after a cold night at sea.
records.translation: Perpektong paraan upang magpainit matapos ang malamig na gabi sa dagat.

records.preserveReason: Chub is the conventional common species name used to distinguish this specific game fish.

records.source: A common freshwater fish known for its voracious appetite.
records.translation: Karaniwang isdang-tabang na kilala sa matakaw na pagkain.

records.source: You can feel a warm glow from within this stone.
records.translation: Madarama mo ang mainit na kinang mula sa loob ng batong ito.

records.source: Break apart to obtain cinder shards.
records.translation: Basagin upang makakuha ng mga Tipak ng Baga.

records.source: There's a chewy little guy in there...
records.translation: May munting makunat na nilalang sa loob...

records.source: A bolt of fine wool cloth.
records.translation: Isang rolyo ng pinong telang lana.

records.source: A combustible rock that is useful for crafting and smelting.
records.translation: Nasusunog na batong kapaki-pakinabang sa paglikha at pagtutunaw.

records.source: Place on the ground to create paths or to spruce up your floors.
records.translation: Ilagay sa lupa upang gumawa ng mga landas o pagandahin ang iyong mga sahig.

records.source: A seed of the coconut palm. It has many culinary uses.
records.translation: Binhi ng punong niyog. Marami itong gamit sa pagluluto.

records.source: It smells delicious. This is sure to give you a boost.
records.translation: Napakabango nito. Tiyak na pasisiglahin ka nito.

records.source: Plant in spring or summer to grow a coffee plant. Place five beans in a keg to make coffee.
records.translation: Itanim sa tagsibol o tag-init upang magpatubo ng halamang kape. Maglagay ng limang butil sa bariles upang gumawa ng kape.

records.source: It's light, fresh and very healthy.
